dashboard.title: Web Automation 跨业务统一度量

targets.query: * AND step: assert AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT COUNT_IF(result = 'success') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value
* AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT AVG(duration_ms) AS value FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '24' hour
* AND token_used > 0 AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT AVG(token_used) AS value FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '24' hour
* AND step: assert AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT COUNT_IF(is_false_positive = 'true') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '24' hour

* AND step: assert AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT date_format(__time__, '%m-%d %H:00') AS time, COUNT_IF(result = 'success') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS success_rate FROM log GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

* AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT date_format(__time__, '%m-%d %H:00') AS time, approx_percentile(duration_ms, 0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile(duration_ms, 0.9) AS p90, approx_percentile(duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99 FROM log GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

* AND token_used > 0 AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT date_format(__time__, '%m-%d') AS time, SUM(token_used) AS total_tokens, AVG(token_used) AS avg_tokens FROM log GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
* AND result: failed AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT error_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '24' hour GROUP BY error_code ORDER BY count DESC
* AND confidence > 0 AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT confidence FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '7' day
* AND result: retrying AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT date_format(__time__, '%m-%d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS retry_count FROM log GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

* AND error_code: COMPLIANCE_BLOCKED AND business_type: $business_type | SELECT date_format(__time__, '%m-%d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS intercept_count FROM log WHERE __time__ > now() - interval '7' day GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: AFD 迭代归档率
panels.description: AFD 视觉迭代归档率（ARCHIVED / 总迭代数）

targets.query: * AND business_type: afd_collab AND event: iteration_archived | SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log WHERE business_type = 'afd_collab' AND event = 'iteration_created') AS archive_rate

panels.title: AFD 买手首审通过率
panels.description: 买手首次审核通过率（不经过补拍）

targets.query: * AND business_type: afd_collab AND event: buyer_first_review | SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'pass') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS first_pass_rate

panels.title: AFD Leader打回率
panels.description: Leader 打回买手或确认驳回的比例

targets.query: * AND business_type: afd_collab AND event: leader_decision | SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision IN ('return_buyer', 'confirm_reject')) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS rework_rate

panels.title: AFD 平均归档周期
panels.description: 迭代从创建到归档的平均天数

targets.query: * AND business_type: afd_collab AND event: iteration_archived | SELECT AVG(archive_days) AS avg_archive_days

* AND business_type: afd_collab AND event: leader_decision AND decision: confirm_reject | SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log WHERE business_type = 'afd_collab' AND event = 'leader_decision') AS reshoot_rate
